content:
Overview

Novi Sad is a city in Vojvodina with a population of 341,000. Serbia’s second-largest city, a cultural hub on the Danube known for the EXIT festival, Petrovaradin Fortress, and its charming old town. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
